primary_unit: A1 vs A3 on byte-identical K=4 candidate pools

authority_events.RESCUE: A1 top-ranked candidate is illegal AND at least one legal candidate exists; A3 selects the highest-scored legal candidate.
authority_events.ABSTAIN: No legal candidate exists; A3 returns no selected output.
authority_events.DORMANT: A1 top-ranked candidate is already legal; A3 necessarily selects the same candidate.
authority_events.GATE_HARM: Impossible by construction with respect to frozen legality: A3 cannot select an illegal candidate. Possible scientific harm can still occur if legality itself overconstrains a valid correction.

primary_promotion.no_global_quality: Neither event promotes better Korean writing.
